estateFacts.use: Estate identity / phase and tower count cross-check. Current page states 7 phases, 52 towers, 10,642 units.

floorPlanSources.note: One mapped typical-floor image for every residential tower; explicit floor ranges and many provider-declared shared-block archetypes.

orientationPolicy: User-provided Centaline/Centamap images are automatically approved. In their absence, explicit north arrows on the primary plans may establish orientation semantics; footprint geometry must never be used to discover an alternative orientation.
